angleRead.name: Trevor Shimizu
angleRead.text: I’m planning to focus on the uptick in ridership at 12th St Oakland City Center, which saw a significant jump of 5,472 riders compared to last cycle. The station’s on-time performance also improved by 4 points, hitting 85%. With events in Downtown and Lake Merritt, plus the Baylight District’s Final Council Vote on construction-planning, there’s a story here about how transit responds to civic momentum. I’ll start by talking to Eleanor Rivera, the BART Station Manager, to get her perspective on the surge and what it means for daily operations.
